bio: One of those restaurants that is well worth recommending for its welcoming atmosphere and honest cuisine, where it has been given a new lease of life by Amalur and Oihane, daughters of the owners. It occupies an attractive house with a bar and dining room, each of which is carefully furnished in rustic style, where guests can enjoy an asador grill-inspired menu featuring premium meat and fish. Pride of place here is given to Galician beef, aged for a maximum of 21 days....
